title: Record drawer v4: a bounded peek over the list — md cap instead of the field-count bucket, no dim overlay, the list stays readable and clickable, ⤢ maximizes in place at the same URL; the full page is reached only from the row ↗ and the header ⋯
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Part of the record-page epic #26676 — how a record opens from a list, **final design** (the maintainer, 2026-10-29: 「设计定稿：按画布 60 重写 #27524 / #27545 的 Target 并回队列」). Design boards: evidence branch `claude/record-page-v2-evidence-20261027b` @ `a7825499aa`, folder `docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/v4/` — `RecordDrawerV4Peek.dc.html` (the default split: the contacts list narrowed to 姓名 · 客户 · 职务 beside a 720 px pane), `RecordDrawerV4Max.dc.html` (the pane maximized over the content area, sidebar kept), `RecordDrawerV4Enlarged.dc.html` (a related list's tab active inside the pane), `notes.md` n46 / n47 / n49 / n50. Read with `git show a7825499aa:<path>`; never merge that branch. Sibling card #27524 owns the page's anatomy (top bar, tab row, panels, tiers); this card owns the container mechanics and may fly in parallel — the two touch different files.

## Source (main `273137d227`)

- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` `overlayWidthFor('auto', objectDef)` returns `min(92vw, <bucket>)` with the bucket derived from the field count (sm 480 / md 720 / lg 960 / xl 1200 / full 1600); `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` lets the reader drag to 95vw and remembers the width under `drawer-width:<object>`. On a 1440 px window a contact's drawer is 960–1200 px, draggable to 1368, while the full page's body is 1136 px (「drawer 已经很宽了，全屏之后更窄了」).
- The drawer is a Radix `Sheet` with the `bg-black/80` overlay: the list behind it is dimmed and dead (「抽屉盖住了列表合理吗」 — ruled no; 「建议把列表缩窄吗」 — ruled yes).
- The drawer bar's ⤢ (`handleExpandDrawer`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` on today's main) closes the drawer and routes to `/record/:id?from=…`; the page offers 「收为抽屉」.
- The Display menu's 「Open records」 section (#27031) already stores the reader's drawer | split preference; the list row's name cell has ↗ 「在整页打开」 (#27031); `useSidebar().sidebarWidth` does not exist — the width is the `--sidebar-width` CSS variable (ui seat 2's premise check, comment 6497733492).

## Target (maintainer rulings of 2026-10-29, verbatim where quoted; not re-decidable here)

1. **Split is the default.** Opening a record from a list narrows the list to the remaining width and mounts the record pane beside it, 720 px by default (`size: 'auto'` resolves to md for the record pane regardless of the field count; the field-count buckets remain for an authored `size` and for the task-flow modal). The reader drags the divider between 360 px and 60vw; the width is remembered per object as today. The list stays fully readable and clickable: at ≥ ~440 px it draws its columns (first 3 non-avatar view columns), narrower it draws card rows (name + two chips); clicking another row swaps the pane's root record (nested levels dropped); the selected row is highlighted and, after ↓ ↑ stepping, follows the stepping and scrolls into view (the Asana desync, not). No dim, non-modal.
2. **The overlay drawer** stays as the reader's preference (the #27031 Display menu gains the third option 「整页」 for Attio-style readers who want the row click to open the page) and as the automatic fallback when the content area is narrower than ~1000 px; it draws without the Sheet overlay and non-modal too (「列表还是可以点，可以切换记录」).
3. **⤢ maximizes in place, keeping the sidebar** (「抽屉 ⤢ 原地最大化 我觉得有必要」; 「最大化之后需要盖住左侧菜单吗」 — no): the pane fills the content area (100vw − the sidebar's live width, read from `--sidebar-width`; a collapsed sidebar makes it wider; a sidebar click closes the pane and navigates); the list is hidden while maximized; the URL stays `?recordId=`, no history entry, the list's scroll and the stack untouched. The top bar (#27524 item 7, shared) stays in place with ⤢ turned into ⤡; ⤡ or Esc restores the split width, ✕ closes the whole path. Not remembered; the next open is split again. Nested levels and an active related-list tab share the bound and the maximize.
4. **The full page only from ↗ and ⋯.** 「在整页打开」 leaves the pane bar: the list row's ↗ (#27031, unchanged) and the last item of the record header's ⋯ menu. `handleExpandDrawer`'s route hop retires; the page's 「收为抽屉」 stays for readers who arrived through ↗ (「界面会卡，价值是什么？」).
5. **Stepping never blanks.** ↓ ↑ keep the previous record's content until the next arrives (a skeleton only on the first open); the next and previous records are prefetched (the #27056 prefetch face); `?recordId=` updates must not re-render the list (Twenty's lesson: twentyhq/twenty#27438 cut row renders per open from 244 to 4, #28517 measured 0.4–0.9 s pauses).
6. No metadata key is added or changed; ⛔ `packages/spec/**`.

## File surface

`ui/packages/plugin-view/src/recordSurface.ts` (the pane's `auto` width), `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx` (split as default, overlay-less non-modal Sheet, drag range, maximize state, ⤢ / ⤡ bar), `ui/packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx` / `ui/sidebar.tsx` only if `hideOverlay` / `modal` / the width variable need a prop, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (retire the route hop; row click swaps the record while open; selection follows stepping), `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx` (maximize across levels), the Display menu's third option, the list's narrow face (`ui/packages/plugin-list` / `plugin-grid`), the record header ⋯ item, i18n in all ten packs, tests beside, changeset; ⛔ #27524's top bar, tab row, panels and tier rule.

## Acceptance

1. Tests per target item: a 20-field object's pane opens at 720; the drag range 360–60vw and a remembered 1300 clamps; the list narrows and stays clickable, a row click swaps the root record, the selection follows ↓ ↑ and scrolls into view; the overlay drawer mounts no overlay and is non-modal; the fallback below ~1000 px; ⤢ keeps the URL, adds no history entry, hides the list, and the width equals 100vw minus the live sidebar width (follows a collapse); Esc from maximized restores, Esc from split closes; the ⋯ menu carries 「在整页打开」 and the bar no longer routes; stepping keeps the previous content; the list does not re-render on a `?recordId=` change (a render-count test).
2. Screenshots on HotCRM contacts at 1440 with the sidebar open — the split at its default width with the list readable beside it, after clicking another row, maximized, and the overlay fallback at 1000 px — on a never-merged evidence branch, linked from the PR body.
3. The epic seat verifies the PR in the console preview against the boards before ACCEPT (maintainer: 「车队开发完后你审核效果」).
4. #26679 / #27031 pins updated to the new anatomy, not deleted.

<sub>Rewritten by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-29 after the maintainer's 定稿 on canvas version 60; the earlier Target (bounded peek, 2026-10-29 noon) is superseded in full. Released by ui seat 2 at 13:21Z on the premise change (comment 6497849202); its branch `claude/project-thread-u1jvzg` carries no commits of value to this Target.</sub>
